spans.text: Cite all sources using APA style and ensure that all findings are supported by evidence.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly requires citing all sources using APA style and ensuring all findings are supported by evidence. It also requires maintaining an objective, academic tone, which promotes information integrity and truthfulness in reporting.

spans.text: Focus solely on report writing; do not perform data analysis or create visualizations.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly constrains the agent's scope of action, preventing it from performing data analysis or creating visualizations. This follows a least-privilege approach by limiting the agent to report writing only, which reduces the risk of unintended actions.

spans.text: Maintain an objective, academic tone throughout the report.
spans.note: The prompt requires maintaining an objective, academic tone throughout the report, which promotes neutrality and balanced presentation of information. This implicitly supports fairness in how research findings are presented.
